gates.name: InnerTube operations
gates.evidence: Live: video metadata, search with filters and continuations, playlists, mixes, channels, comments, chapters; videoInfo falls back to the watch page when the bot check withholds details

gates.name: Player compatibility
gates.evidence: Live 2026-11-02: VISIONOS (no player script, no streaming token) answers OK with direct URLs for dQw4w9WgXcQ, and eXcor extracts from it. Its player request no longer sends youtube.com's Referer, which YouTube answers with 403. PlayerJsTest passes offline. Owner's PC, home network (Switzerland), 2026-11-03: the watch page loads (HTTP 200). Three bugs had kept the player-script path from ever starting, now fixed: the script URL is read from the page config (jsUrl, PLAYER_JS_URL) because the player response no longer carries assets.js; the 2.66 MB script exceeded the 2 MB fetch cap; and the EJS solver ran out of QuickJS memory at 64 MiB (it needs 256). The live player (sts 20754 and 20759) now solves: n and sig challenges both return answers, about 6 s cold. TVHTML5 then sends its player request, and YouTube answers it UNPLAYABLE (dQw4w9WgXcQ) or LOGIN_REQUIRED (kJQP7kiw5Fk)
blockers: No video was served to TVHTML5 on the owner's network either (UNPLAYABLE or LOGIN_REQUIRED), so no stream deciphered by the player script has been played. Cloud containers get a captcha instead of the watch page

gates.name: Streaming
gates.evidence: Live 2026-11-02 (LivePlaybackTest.extractedAudioDecodesFullyAndSeeks): eXcor extracted Opus/WebM audio for dQw4w9WgXcQ, the full 3,433,755-byte file decoded with ffmpeg without errors (213.06 s against a 213 s video), and a mid-file range read landed at the requested offset. The probe follows googlevideo's 302 to another allowlisted node. Video, live 2026-11-03 (LivePlaybackTest.extractedVideoAndAudioDecodeAndMux): extractVideo picked 480p H.264 (854x480, 14,103,519 bytes) and, with EXCOR_VIDEO_HEIGHT=1080, 1080p H.264 (1920x1080, 80,911,999 bytes) from VISIONOS; each was downloaded in 4 MiB range reads, muxed with its M4A audio by ffmpeg without re-encoding, fully decoded (213.09 s), and range-read from the middle. Rerun 2026-11-03 from a second cloud container: the audio decode, the 480p mux and the 27-format list pass again for dQw4w9WgXcQ. Owner's PC, home network, 2026-11-03: the same picture as the cloud: the 27-format list (144p to 2160p, all range-readable) and Opus audio for dQw4w9WgXcQ from VISIONOS; kJQP7kiw5Fk is LOGIN_REQUIRED on every client. ffmpeg was not installed, so the decode and mux tests were skipped there
blockers: Most videos are still bot-checked or unavailable to every client from cloud containers (first session: kJQP7kiw5Fk unavailable; JGwWNGJdvx8, FGBhQbmPwH8, 9bZkp7q19f0 bot-checked. Second session, 2026-11-03: the same, and jNQXAC9IVRw and PkZNo7MFNFg bot-checked too), so publicMusicVideosReturnRangeReadableAudio fails on its second video there
The owner's home network and phone (mobile data) bot-check most videos too, so this is not specific to cloud IPs

gates.name: SABR/UMP
gates.evidence: No network/playback transport is implemented. PR #84 merged an offline bounded UMP frame decoder, and PR #86 merged offline HTTP-response continuation assembly after all six supported-target CI jobs passed. Neither makes network requests or decodes media. G6 remains blocked; SABR/UMP playback 0/20.
blockers: No complete independently validated request/response contract, authorized playable stream, full decode, or seek evidence.

gates.name: YouTube Music
gates.evidence: Live: search with filters and continuations, suggestions, artist pages, playlists, radio; a top result card that plays is typed with its video ID (2026-11-03). Songs and albums are withheld from cloud containers (rechecked 2026-11-03). Owner's PC, home network, 2026-11-03: YouTube Music offers Songs and Albums there. LiveVideoInfoTest.youTubeMusicSongsAndAlbums passes: the Songs filter gives typed songs with video IDs, durations (now read from the subtitle; they were missing), album and artist links; the Albums filter gives albums whose playlists list their tracks; the artist page has a Top songs shelf and album shelves. Fixed on the way: the artist page's radio and shuffle playlist IDs, which YouTube now sends in a watchEndpoint
blockers: Discographies (an artist's full album list) are not covered by a live check yet

gates.name: Reliability
gates.evidence: Supported-target CI passed for merged PR #80 synthetic tests: bounded Retry-After/backoff, cancellation, declared/actual oversized responses, foreign media redirects and credential-safe logs. PR #81 adds session-generation invalidation for player, media and format results, also passing all six supported-target CI jobs. Live endpoint fault injection is still unverified.
blockers: No owner-run fault-injection against an authorized live endpoint; synthetic coverage does not establish live playback reliability.
Two nulls in an earlier live run passed on reruns and have not been reproduced.

gates.name: Security
gates.evidence: URL allowlist, safe data-class/log rendering, bounded responses and OSV dependency scan remain in place. PR #76 diagnostic sanitization and PR #82 bounded response reads merged after supported-target CI; #80/#81 add redirect credential-isolation and stale-session protection. The dependency scan found no known vulnerabilities in 115 shipped packages on 2026-11-02. Full diagnostic-surface review remains open.
gates.command: see the 'Dependency vulnerability scan' step in .github/workflows/ci.yml
blockers: Android lint tooling has report-only findings (guava, commons-lang3, httpclient, bouncycastle); these are supplied by the Android Gradle plugin and are not shipped.
The remaining exception and data-class diagnostic audit is in draft PR #87 and is not counted until it merges with supported-target CI.
